title: External Input Non-Republication Principle Record
description: Schema for recording compliance with the External Input Non-Republication Principle.

input_id.description: Unique identifier for the external input

access_channel.description: Channel through which access was obtained (public, paywall, private account, institutional login, etc.)

original_license.description: License under which the original work is distributed

provenance_chain.description: Chain of custody from original source to current possession

non_republication_certified.description: Certification that the original text will not be republished

allowed_use.description: What use is permitted for this input

quotation_limit.description: Maximum quotation length if brief_quotation is allowed
